OpenCard is an act of solidarity with people who care about their privacy and need simple tools.\n\nTools that do exactly what you expect, without constantly pushing services you\'re not interested in.
What the app does, how to add a card and where to download it for iOS and Android.
OpenCard\'s code is public. It\'s available on GitHub under the AGPL v3 license: you can read it, build it and check that the app does only what it says.

OpenCard collects nothing and doesn\'t even have permission to connect to the internet: your cards stay in the app\'s private storage. The page below says it in full, and it\'s the one declared to Google and Apple.
By default the cards do not go into the automatic backup to Google\'s cloud: you turn it on in Settings. If you change phone you take them with you through a backup file or the QR transfer.

The cards go into the Android automatic backup and end up on Google\'s cloud along with other apps\' data. On a new phone you get them back the first time you open the app.
The cards stay on this phone and never leave it. To take them elsewhere use Export to file or the QR transfer.
